verdict.rationale: Receipt capture is a fair question for a business account that issues cards, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions receipts, emailing receipts in, or automatically matching them to transactions. The dispute file uploads and card-transaction retrieval in the pack are adjacent features from other stories and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have receipts automatically attached to the right transaction by emailing or uploading them
